audit.why: Engage-vs-engage mirror is correctly identified as EVEN in tone/diff already; the 47.88% win rate confirms it's close to a coinflip, not a Maokai blowout.
Spikes correctly key level 2 (W-Q available before Braum passive completes) and level 6 (Nature's Grasp proactive vs Glacial Fissure reactive).

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flags four ability interactions not stated anywhere on the page: Glacial Fissure (R) grounds Twisted Advance (W), Bramble Smash (Q) grounds Stand Behind Me (W), the mutual knockup race (Q/E vs R), and Winter's Bite/Unbreakable absorbing burst.
audit.why: These are decisive mechanical facts (both sides can deny the other's dash) that change how the all-in should be played, and neither appears in breakdown.cooldowns, dos/don'ts, or report.
audit.corrected: Folded the two dash-grounding facts into breakdown.cooldowns (mutual grounding is the core cooldown-tracking behavior for this matchup); the shield-absorbs-burst and knockup-race facts were already implicit in tradeGood/breakdown.trading and left as-is to avoid template bloat.

edits.before: - Braum Unbreakable: matchup-defining — The shield wall eats your poke and engage projectiles — wait it out. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your Q Bramble Smash answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Braum's Unbreakable (E) blocks projectiles, up to 16s early, 8s late — hold your engage until it's down. - Your Q Bramble Smash grounds his W dash on a 7s cooldown (5s maxed) — save it for the chain, not the poke. - His R sits on a 130s cooldown; punish the wait.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Your W-Q lands the root before Concussive Blows stacks four hits — commit onto their carry, not the tank shield.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: Nature's Grasp is a 130s early commitment — don't burn it chasing a Fissure that never lands.

edits.before: Your level-1 W-Q all-in beats Braum before he stacks his passive.
edits.after: Level 1 is a skill check: land W-Q before Braum stacks his passive.

edits.before: At level 2 you set the tempo while his concussive stun isn't online.
edits.after: At level 2 tempo is contested while his concussive stun isn't online.

edits.before: At level 3 you engage first and keep him reacting.
edits.after: At level 3 it is a race to engage first and stay ahead.

edits.before: At 4-5 every fight starts on your terms as the engage support.
edits.after: At 4-5 engage terms are shared between both engage supports.

edits.before: Level 6 favours you: proactive Nature's Grasp beats his reactive ult.
edits.after: Level 6 is close: proactive Nature's Grasp against his reactive ult.

edits.before: With 2+ items your W-R lockdown out-initiates his defensive peel.
edits.after: With 2+ items it is your W-R lockdown against his defensive peel.
